name: b24_user
description: Synchronizes Drupal users with Bitrix24 contacts (live on user CRUD, plus batch export and import).
project_description: Submodule of b24. Synchronizes Drupal users with Bitrix24 contacts: live export on user insert/update/delete (filtered by role), a batch export form for existing users, and a batch import form that creates Drupal users from Bitrix24 contacts. Field values are mapped from user/profile tokens and de-duplicated against the shared b24_reference table.
